description: Lightfield is an AI-native CRM that automatically captures emails, meetings, and other customer interactions to build and update relationship records. It provides a shared customer-memory model and agent layer for sales workflows, reporting, and automations.
summary: Lightfield exposes a beta REST API at `api.lightfield.app/v1`, a `lightfield` CLI, and a Streamable HTTP MCP server at `mcp.lightfield.app/mcp`; the REST API and CLI use admin-created API keys, while the MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 via the MCP client flow.
